mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed segment projects the plateau height of 78 onto the vertical axis. Right image: The dashed line aligns the peak with its output value of 900.
Rationales: In both images the feature connects a feature of the graph to its vertical-axis value. The horizontal dashed segment from 78 to the graph’s left plateau corner. The dashed horizontal segment from 900 to the graph’s peak.
